interactions_parent_check.name: interactions_parent_check
interactions_parent_check.value: "interactions"."organization_id" is not null or "interactions"."contact_id" is not null

organizations_budget_check.name: organizations_budget_check
organizations_budget_check.value:
("organizations"."budget_min_cents" is null or "organizations"."budget_min_cents" >= 0)
          and ("organizations"."budget_max_cents" is null or "organizations"."budget_max_cents" >= 0)
          and ("organizations"."budget_min_cents" is null or "organizations"."budget_max_cents" is null
               or "organizations"."budget_max_cents" >= "organizations"."budget_min_cents")

tasks_parent_check.name: tasks_parent_check
tasks_parent_check.value: "tasks"."conversation_id" is not null or "tasks"."deal_id" is not null
